chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
If you pray with them, you will be forgiven according to the number of those who oppose you.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.بِعَدَدِ: in proportion to the number of
key_terms.خالَفَكَ: those who opposed or differed from you

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for praying with those who differ from you?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that praying with others carries immense spiritual reward. The hadith emphasizes forgiveness tied to participating in prayer alongside those who differ from one, highlighting both devotional merit and communal benefit.
